company.name: Convex
company.shortDescription: Convex provides a backend platform with a reactive database, serverless functions, and real-time data synchronization for web apps
company.description: Convex provides a backend development platform that combines a reactive database, serverless functions, real-time data synchronization, file storage, and authentication. The platform enables developers to build and deploy web applications without managing backend infrastructure and supports application development using TypeScript and JavaScript.

productsAndServices.description: A serverless, reactive database platform that manages global state for web applications with real-time synchronization and TypeScript-based backend code.
productsAndServices.name: Convex Reactive Database

productsAndServices.description: Modular, independent TypeScript building blocks for backend features, including real-time presence, durable functions, and third-party integrations.
productsAndServices.name: Convex Components

productsAndServices.description: AI-assisted generation of high-quality Convex backend code in TypeScript to accelerate development workflows.
productsAndServices.name: AI Coding with Convex

productsAndServices.description: Support for over 80 OAuth providers to handle user authentication within Convex applications.
productsAndServices.name: Authentication Integrations

productsAndServices.description: The Convex backend is open source, allowing developers to self-host and develop locally for compliance and faster iteration.
productsAndServices.name: Open Source and Self-Hosting

productsAndServices.description: A program offering startups up to one year free access to Convex Professional plan with usage discounts.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $57,000,000, or 51.54% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,424,090 to $400,459,540, a 17.1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 93 (+8 over 90 days) and market heat at 87 (+16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
